context: Asuka lectures on the justice system.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: law lecture; legal vocabulary (裁判/弁護士/犯罪/訴訟/措置) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は、裁判の仕組みを学びます。
lines.en: Today we study how trials work.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 弁護士は、どんな役割ですか?
lines.en: What role does a lawyer play?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 弁護士は、被告の権利を守ります。
lines.en: The lawyer protects the defendant's rights.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 犯罪の裁判は、特に厳しいんですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 犯罪を裁くには、慎重な手続きが要ります。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 訴訟は、誰でも起こせるんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、訴訟は権利を守る措置の一つです。
lines.en: Yes, a lawsuit is one measure to protect rights.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 裁判が、公平さを支えるんですね。
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
